title: SYNTHETIC: Safety update for X-001 (28-day toxicology study)

sections.heading: Toxicology result
sections.text: In a synthetic 28-day toxicology study, X-001 caused dose-dependent liver enzyme elevation in all treated animals at exposures within the range projected from the mouse efficacy model. The study was stopped early on the sponsor's decision.

sections.heading: Interpretation
sections.text: The finding is a negative safety signal for X-001 at efficacious exposures in animals. Human relevance has not been tested.

evidence.excerpt: In a synthetic 28-day toxicology study, X-001 caused dose-dependent liver enzyme elevation in all treated animals at exposures within the range projected from the mouse efficacy model.
limitations: Animal toxicology; human relevance not tested.
